name: TimerUnit
meaning: Unit selector passed to Timer_Convert 0x40b51c and hence to Timer_GetElapsed / Timer_GetDelta / Timer_Peek*. Decoded from the jump table at 0x40b5b8 (entries 0x40b53b, 0x40b543, 0x40b551, 0x40b579).

name: TIMER_TICKS
meaning: raw TSC ticks as a double, no division by g_cpuHz. Used by the game clock's pause path 0x56103f to capture the unconsumed delta.

name: TIMER_SECONDS
meaning: ticks / g_cpuHz. Used by Time_Update (multiplied by 4096 to make g_dtRaw) and by Frame_LimitFps.

name: TIMER_MILLISECONDS
meaning: ticks * 1000 / g_cpuHz, the multiply done in 64-bit before the divide. Used by AnimMesh_UpdateAnim.

name: TIMER_MICROSECONDS
meaning: ticks * 1000000 / g_cpuHz. No caller in the binary.
